messages:
maya: Heads-up — SAST flagged a medium-severity flow in payments-service that looks like an auth bypass when RBAC role names change. PR: https://github.com/redwood/payments/pull/448. Can security look?

omar: ack. can you paste the exact finding text?

maya: Sure — from the scanner: `Potential insecure role check: comparing role string literals without normalization`. Snippet:```go if user.Role == "admin" { allow() } ```

jess: That pattern's been cropping up where role names come from the auth proxy header. We recently changed a service to add a prefix in staging (svc/), which would skip the check.

sol: Also noticed audit logs for that service don't include the header that indicates role_source. So even if we triage, the trails won't show why decision was made.

scans-bot: Automated scan result: SAST ID S-2026-1197; file: auth/authorize.go:142; severity: medium; suggested fix: normalize or use role IDs.

maya: proposed short-term mitigation: update the check to use role IDs (integer) or normalize by trimming `svc/` prefix. Long-term: we should enforce canonical role mapping in auth-proxy. Thoughts?

omar: +1 on preferring role IDs. But that touches DB and token encoding. For a fast patch, normalize strings in the service and add a follow-up ticket for source-of-truth mapping.

jess: I'll take the quick patch in the PR and add tests. Also adding a changelog note for audit.

sol: Can we also ensure audit logs include role_source header? I'm worried for incident response we won't be able to reconstruct.

infra-bot: Note: KMS key access for payments-service currently uses project-sa `payments-runner`. Recent KMS policy change removed decrypt for ephemeral tokens role.

maya: Right — if we change auth token format or role encoding we'll need a KMS rotation plan. We should avoid deploying a patch that requires decrypt until KMS perms are reconciled.

omar: Proposed plan: 1) quick string-normalization patch (no KMS changes) 2) enable extended audit fields in staging (role_source, header_value) 3) spike to migrate to role IDs with a DB-backed mapping and KMS-encrypted signing keys.

jess: I'll push the string-normalize patch now. Will include unit tests and mention the KMS constraint in PR description.

sol: I'll open a ticket for audit enrichment (SEC-1229) and add a short schema for logs so SIEM ingestion isn't broken.

maya: For the audit enrichment, can we add a lightweight schema in logging-lib: `role_source`, `role_raw`, `role_canonical`? If we add that we need to update parsers in ELK.

omar: ELK team FYI — it's safe to add optional fields, we'll coordinate.

scans-bot: Reminder: the next nightly SAST run will re-scan once PR is merged. If fixes pass, scanner will mark as resolved.

jess: PR: https://github.com/redwood/payments/pull/448 (wip) — pushing commit that trims `svc/` and normalizes case.

maya: After merge, let's run a quick DAST smoke in staging to ensure runtime header behavior unchanged. @infra-bot can you schedule?

infra-bot: Scheduling a staging DAST smoke (ticket: DAST-907). ETA 30m after merge.

sol: Also adding a note: we should update the pre-merge checklist to include a quick audit-fields check for services that do auth decisions. Might prevent this class of bugs.

omar: Agree. I'll add a checklist item to the pipeline config: `check-audit-fields` that runs a linter against instrumentation annotations.

maya: Assigning owners: jess -> patch and tests; sol -> audit ticket and ELK schema; omar -> pipeline checklist update; maya -> coordinate KMS follow-up spike.

jess: on it, will request review from @omar and @maya. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — closing loop here after DAST smoke and scan pass. If anything fails, escalate to sec-oncall.

sol: Noted. Leaving a postmortem-lite template in SEC-1229 so we can capture timeline if it becomes an incident.

scans-bot: Action: ticket SEC-1229 created and linked to PR.

maya: one more micro-note — when we do the KMS-signed tokens design, let's ensure keystore rotation is testable in staging without global key changes. We learned that the last rotation caused transient auth failures.

omar: good call. we'll plan ephemeral test keys and a rollback path.

jess: merging patch now. will watch for DAST job and post results here.

infra-bot: DAST smoke started at 1765123620; report will post to the channel when done.

maya: thanks everyone.
